captions.detailed: A cylindrical 3D-printed adapter base featuring a wide, flat circular flange at the bottom and a narrower, taller cylindrical column rising from the center. The central column has six thin, vertical rectangular ribs distributed evenly around its outer surface to ensure a snug friction fit inside a tube. A continuous, clean circular bore hole runs vertically through the entire center of the part from top to bottom.
captions.instruction: Design a parametric solar light replacement base in OpenSCAD with an adjustable wide bottom flange, a central male cylinder to slide into the light pole, a customizable central bore hole for a mounting nail, and axial outer ribs on the male cylinder to ensure a snug fit.
captions.factory: The script uses a difference() operation to subtract a central cylinder (representing the bore hole of diameter B) from a union of three main components: a thin bottom base cylinder of diameter D2 and height H2, a central male cylinder of height H and diameter D, and a custom 'ribs' module. The 'ribs' module uses a for-loop to rotate and translate rectangular cubes radially around the central cylinder axis based on the number of ribs, rib thickness, and target diameter.
